goal: Allow running the transaction index on pruned nodes without storing hundreds of gigabytes of raw block data

agreement: Strong support with substantive review and no open objections

Verified by testing reindexing on a pruned node and querying transactions (optout21)
Code review approval with nonblocking cleanups and suggestions (fjahr, l0rinc)
